state_normalization: not fitted; raw physical features must be normalized using training split only
rotation_composition: rotvec in radians, left-compose with fresh measured TCP rotation

image_slots.base_0_rgb: one RGB-D camera RGB; true mask

target_provenance: actual RGB-D surface tracker required; no simulator ground truth
depth: registered metric depth + validity mask, used by external tracker; not a native pi05 depth channel

hall.measurement: ADC raw -> Hall voltage V -> existing real ForceCalibration

rgbd.depth: registered metric optical-Z and validity for bounded rigid-torso RGB-D tracker; geometry enters 32-state prompt

tcp_geometry.compression: estimated from the same Hall ADC packet
tcp_geometry.offset_basis: existing CAD/scene convention, not new physical calibration

force_reference_semantics.operating_scale: existing Hall spring-load calibration; not independently verified patient contact force
force_reference_semantics.zero_in_other_phases: inactive force reference; does not mean unloaded Hall must read 0 N
force_reference_semantics.release_test: requires Hall baseline plus independently estimated geometry; do not reuse V1 hall_N<0.2 rule

action_definition: next commanded TCP pose relative to current measured-joint FK plus current Hall-estimated compression; includes servo lag
